items: Pain after a fall on a hand

caption:
Push-ups and planks leaving Lulu's wrists sore?

Both hold the wrist bent right back while it carries a lot of bodyweight. If you've just started, or ramped up quickly, the wrist often just needs time to catch up.

Start with the set-up: spread your fingers and press through the knuckles. Put your hands on a bench for a while, use push-up handles, or switch to forearm planks. Add slow wrist curls two or three times a week.

Pain after a fall on an outstretched hand, swelling or a tender spot on the thumb side is worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 💪
